name: project-kit
description: Create, audit and upgrade software projects from the project-kit-cookiecutter templates, with spec-kit, linting and a changelog set up, and maintain their changelogs, releases, pull requests and documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Create, upgrade and audit projects from the project-kit templates
interface.longDescription: Create Python and Node projects from the project-kit-cookiecutter templates, keep them up to date with cruft and audit them for drift; keep a Keep a Changelog CHANGELOG.md, cut releases, split work into stacked pull requests, and write documentation with the Diátaxis framework and the house editorial style.
defaultPrompt: Start a new Python project called flow-tools
Audit this repository against our standards
Update the changelog from the commits since the last release
